content: GitHub code scanning SARIF constraints (docs.github.com, cross-checked with OASIS spec): max 10MB gzip-compressed, max 20 runs/file, 25000 results/run (top 5000 displayed by severity), rules require id + shortDescription.text + fullDescription.text + help.text (<=1024 chars), results require message.text + >=1 location, only primaryLocationLineHash within partialFingerprints is actually used for cross-commit dedup, symlinked file targets are silently dropped from display.
